_meta.name: principal_components
_meta.description: Principal component analysis of a six-item engagement battery on battery.pulse (1-5 ratings on one latent trait) on its correlation matrix: the loadings of the components kept by the Kaiser rule (eigenvalue above 1) as a rectangular members x components primary, the eigenvectors as auxiliary, every eigenvalue with its explained and cumulative variance share, the communalities, the KMO measure of sampling adequacy (overall and per measure) and Bartlett's sphericity test. Set params.components to an integer k or {"variance": share} to keep a fixed number or a share of the spread; params.on "covariance" decomposes the covariance instead (components then required). Here one component dominates: its eigenvalue is about 3.2 (about 53% of the variance) while the next is below 0.7, every item loads on it, the reverse-worded bat_dread with the opposite sign, and KMO is about 0.87, meritorious by Kaiser (1974). Streamable and mergeable; no rotation.
